YOUR INTRODUCTION
With over 30 years of living in the Chattanooga area and a background that spans the Marine Corps, finance, and hospitality management, I bring unique insight and commitment to my clients. Partnering with Realty One Group Experts, I use cutting-edge tools and genuine local knowledge to streamline your real estate experience.
